explication: This is a browser-based WebGL fluid simulation: users interact with a canvas and adjust simulation and visual settings. The visible code shows pointer event handling, GPU-based fluid calculations, and optional bloom and sunray effects during rendering. The implementation is concentrated in one source file. Because excerpts omit portions of the runtime loop, links from pointer input to simulation updates and from rendering to the displayed canvas are not asserted.
